epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the container stack for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose file, so that the product can be launched and verified for real.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root,
When I run docker-compose up,
Then the full stack starts successfully and exposes a health-check endpoint.
Given the stack is running,
When I execute the QA validation script,
Then all integrated container tests pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local environment startup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Provide UI for updating and deleting existing epidemiological materials

slices.title: Add UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system,
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint and the catalog is updated accordingly.
Given the UI update or delete action is complete,
When automated QA tests are run,
Then the changes are successfully validated end-to-end without regressions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or delete a material from manual DB edit >5 mins to <30 seconds via UI

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized data access incidents from >0 per month to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Implement standard authentication and session mechanism to block unauthenticated users and prompt them to log in

slices.title: Enforce authentication on catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given the authentication check is enforced,
When security QA tests run,
Then they confirm unauthorized endpoints return 401 and redirect appropriately.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase unauthorized request rejection rate from 0% to 100%
